newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan starts strategic income fund.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan starts strategic income fund.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said it launched the JPM Institutional Global Strategic Income Fund, a no-load fund that will invest in a wide range of fixed-income and related securities.
The portfolio will include non-dollar securities, non-securitized mortgages, corporate private placements, emerging market debt, and high-yield corporates.
The fund will also buy traditional money market, U.S. government, domestic investment grade corporate and securitized mortgage investments.
Gerard Lillis and Mark Smith co-manage the fund.
